expectations.text: A design doc file exists with clear structure
expectations.evidence: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md exists but is an informal plan, not a structured design doc with the standard sections.

expectations.text: Design doc includes Summary, Motivation, Design, Alternatives, and Testing Plan sections
expectations.evidence: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md has Overview, Design Decisions, File Structure, Testing Strategy — but no Motivation, no Alternatives Considered, no formal structure.

expectations.text: A feature branch name is specified
expectations.evidence: No branch name mentioned anywhere in the outputs.

expectations.text: Implementation uses serde/serde_json for JSON serialization
expectations.evidence: Cargo.toml includes serde and serde_json. OutputFormat enum dispatches to serde_json serialization.

expectations.text: Tests cover both human-readable and JSON output modes
expectations.evidence: 9 integration tests covering human mode (no JSON braces) and JSON mode (valid parseable JSON) for all subcommands.

expectations.text: Evidence of review/quality pass (clippy, fmt, test commands mentioned)
expectations.evidence: No review process, no mention of cargo fmt/clippy/test workflow.
